decisions.statement: A scope is the global scope or a named character or a named companion.
A character scope names the character by its ESO character identity.
A companion scope names the companion by its companion identity.
A toggle characters and companions both carry needs a target naming the side.
A target contradicting the one side its toggle applies to is refused.
A target stated outside the global scope is refused.
A toggle the named side does not carry is refused before anything changes.
A refusal names every toggle the side does carry.
A value of nothing takes the toggle away rather than switching that toggle off.
A toggle taken away falls back to the value the global scope has.
Settings come back new rather than changed in place.
Nothing here reads or writes a file.

definition: the settings that follow from switching one toggle in one scope
